routeAdjustment: The archived source splits two exceptional exponent cases. The existing terminal-flag theorem allows a shorter single next-degree argument: two successive exceptions would force p-1 to divide two. discharged: The actual nonzero binary-flag character eigensystem feeds a nonzero original trivial-coefficient H1 eigensystem at level Q*p in every prime characteristic at least five, with the exact good-prime twist ell^t under the source congruence (p-1) divides sourceBinaryFlagExponentOf(p,n,j)+2*t. The Eisenstein alternative is removed by the actual nonzero Eisenstein class at the next flag degree; a second exception would imply p-1 divides two. When both character and twist exponents are divisible by p-1, the same-level result holds in every prime characteristic, including all characteristic-two cases. No survival, character identification, scalar agreement or Eisenstein eigenclass is assumed.
